svg.text: The page grid: 43 columns x 55 rows of 14.17pt (5mm) boxes
Drawn to scale on US Letter (612 x 792pt). Pages are written in grid coordinates; GridSystem converts them to Prawn points.
Prawn origin (0, 0): bottom-left, y grows upward
pink: 12.65pt below row 54 and 2.69pt right of col 42 are off-grid
grid.y returns a big number for row 0:
row 0 is the top, Prawn y is from the bottom.
Prawn text_box at: is the top-left corner,
but its y is still measured from the bottom.
Link rects are [left, bottom, right, top]:
Inside a bounding_box, (0, 0) moves to the
